snippet.title: Strongloween: The Escape - New Trailer [EN] - François Linck Games
snippet.description:
(This is a new version of official trailer)
François Linck Games presents Strongloween: The Escape.

Here is the official trailer for my first video game which is announced for May 8, 2024.
A demo is available on Steam, (and Itch.io) add the game to your wishlist now so you don't miss the game's release!

TWITTER : https://twitter.com/f_linck_Games
STEAM : https://store.steampowered.com/app/1917820/Strongloween_The_Escape/
ITCH.IO : https://francois-linck.itch.io/strongloween-the-escape
